نتناثر (form VI)
# نَتَنَاثَرُ (natanāṯaru) /na.ta.naː.θa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# نَتَنَاثَرَ (natanāṯara) /na.ta.naː.θa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# نَتَنَاثَرْ (natanāṯar) /na.ta.naː.θar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
